smell_validity.evidence: Six adapters must each publish one 16-member union record (keyed, capacity, text, ordering...), filling 40+ no-op 'unsupported' stubs because helpers dispatch blindly and refusal answers are contractually pinned by test103. The forced implementation-side dependence is the design's stated price; per-capability records draw the healthy boundary. The fault and its six-way ripple cost are unmistakable unlabeled.

maintenance_impact.evidence: The union record makes every capability decision a six-way agreement: record members, six stub sets, refusal conventions and pinned test output must move together, and a missed adapter update zero-fills a pointer member into a silent runtime NULL-dispatch crash. Removing it restores per-kind capability ownership; the burden is one subsystem, not architectural.

development_plausibility.evidence: Deep fit: version macro, UTCONTAINER_UNUSED mirroring UTARRAY_UNUSED, tail adapter sections like utstring's appendix, icd reuse, HASH_JEN internals avoiding overridable HASH_FUNCTION macros, test103 plus .ans registered like every suite program. The merged-record compromise reads like a real facade tradeoff, though the all-six-kinds union landing at once looks feature-shaped rather than gradual.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: Bounded areas, frozen helper API and refusal contract, byte-identical test103.ans, and the dead-stub ban decisively block wrong direction, incomplete cleanup and unrelated redesign; the co-served-capability clause and open design choice prevent over-splitting while permitting several sound shapes. Problem, finished state, preservation boundary and near-misses are all resolved; a model contract preventing costly misdirection.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Three stages need distinct decisions: structure/dispatch redesign in utcontainer.h; authoring per-member refusal so 16 helpers keep NULL/0/-1/no-effect answers without stub members; and per-kind capability classification (ring pop refused under overwrite, string capacity refused, list-only reverse), each answer grounded in that kind's real vocabulary.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt names the areas (utcontainer.h plus each container header), and the six adapter tail blocks are found by one trivial search for the facade banner or UT_ops; the only other caller (test103) uses just the named helpers and must behave identically. No cross-component tracing or exclusion analysis is needed.

repair_coordination.evidence: Rules interlock: banning adapter-side stubs forces refusal logic into the dispatch layer, which in turn forces the handle to represent absent capabilities; all six publications, constructors and the byte-pinned test must migrate in one sweep. Partial migration fails loudly on type mismatches, so a silent cross-stage failure is not established.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: One template repairs essentially all locations: split the record into capability groups, have helpers refuse absent groups with the documented per-member values, and republish each adapter keeping only members not marked '_unsupported'; the labels and preserved function bodies carry every per-kind judgement with no new behavioral decision.

behavioral_risk.evidence: The recorded .ans pins every helper's output for every kind and refusal, so a compiling misclassification, miswired member or wrong refusal value appears as an ordinary, diff-caught wrong result on the first suite run; only untested outlier paths (constructor malloc-failure guards) escape it.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
